_comment: Reference copy of the MCP servers install.sh configures. To apply manually: claude mcp add-json <name> '<json>' --scope user. Keyed servers need the matching var in .env.

context7._why: Pulls up-to-date, version-correct library docs into context. Kills hallucinated APIs.

playwright._why: Claude drives a real browser: clicks, screenshots, checks its own front-end work.

fetch._why: Fetch any URL as clean markdown. No key.

sequential-thinking._why: Structured step-by-step reasoning for hard problems.

exa._why: Neural web search built for agents. Better than keyword search for research.

tavily._why: LLM-optimised search with citations. Good for IB research + EE.

supabase._why: Claude manages your Postgres DB, migrations, and auth directly.

github._why: Read/write issues, PRs, code across your repos. OAuth — run 'claude mcp login github' once.
